biggest_catch: Only people who have not been a primary owner of a KeyBank personal checking account in the last 12 months qualify, and account-opening promo offers in branch may differ from online.
catches: $300: Open a Key Smart Checking account online by December 11, 2026 at 11:59 p.m. EST with offer code KDMA0526, make the $10 minimum opening deposit, and receive a total of $2,000 or more in eligible direct deposits within 90 days of account opening.

$500: Open a Key Select Checking account by December 11, 2026 with offer code KDMB0526, make the $50 minimum opening deposit, and receive a total of $5,000 or more in eligible direct deposits within 90 days of account opening.
Eligible direct deposits are electronic ACH deposits: payroll, Social Security, pension, and government benefits. Deposits made through a teller, ATM, or the KeyBank mobile app are ineligible.
Valid Social Security Number or Taxpayer Identification Number and US address required; non-residents must open in a KeyBank branch; this offer is redeemable online only.
Employees of KeyBank, its affiliates and subsidiaries are not eligible.
Limit one account-opening gift per qualifying account; limit one per individual.
The value of the gift is reported on IRS Form 1099-INT and is deposited within 60 days of meeting requirements.
Offer not available to individuals who were a primary account owner of a KeyBank personal checking account in the last 12 months; account must not be closed at the time of gift payment.
Offer is subject to cancellation without notice; geographic restrictions apply and account opening is subject to approval.

steps: Open a Key Smart Checking account online by December 11, 2026 (offer code KDMA0526, $10 minimum deposit) or a Key Select Checking account (offer code KDMB0526, $50 minimum deposit).
Within 90 days of opening, receive a total of $2,000+ ($300) or $5,000+ ($500) in eligible ACH direct deposits (payroll, Social Security, pension, government benefits).
Keep the account open through gift payment.
The cash gift is deposited within 60 days of meeting requirements.
Expect the gift to be reported on IRS Form 1099-INT as taxable income.
